facts.value: Manus AI is an autonomous general AI agent designed to complete tasks and deliver results… Think of Manus AI as a virtual colleague with its own computer

sources.value: Workflows are systems where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths. Agents, on the other hand, are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, maintaining control over how they accomplish tasks.
The autonomous nature of agents means higher costs, and the potential for compounding errors.
If we exceed the max_turns passed, we raise a MaxTurnsExceeded exception.
Use the human-in-the-loop (HITL) flow to pause agent execution until a person approves or rejects sensitive tool calls.
